## Structure and components

- [statement] In the textbook's time-series cross-validation procedure, each training set contains observations prior to its test observation. (low confidence) — https://otexts.robjhyndman.com/fpp2/accuracy.html
- [statement] A Federal Reserve working paper describes two-step overlapping forecast errors sharing a component and exhibiting serial and cross-horizon correlation in its example. (low confidence) — https://www.clevelandfed.org/-/media/project/clevelandfedtenant/clevelandfedsite/publications/working-papers/2018/wp1715r.pdf

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Forecast evaluation guidance warns against leakage in rolling-origin evaluation and in preprocessing including smoothing, decomposition and normalization. (low confidence) — https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10618-022-00894-5
- [statement] Forecast evaluation guidance recommends comparing models with suitable simple benchmarks. (low confidence) — https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10618-022-00894-5
- [statement] Rolling-origin evaluation repeatedly advances the forecast origin and produces forecasts from each origin. (low confidence) — https://openforecast.org/adam/rollingOrigin.html
- [statement] The textbook describes extending rolling-origin cross-validation to multi-step forecast errors. (low confidence) — https://otexts.robjhyndman.com/fpp2/accuracy.html
- [statement] Hyndman's forecasting guidance says the test set must not be used for model development or for calculating forecasts. (low confidence) — https://robjhyndman.com/nyc2018/1-3-ForecastEvaluation.pdf
- [statement] The forecasting evaluation study describes prequential evaluation as using each observation to test the model before using it for training. (low confidence) — https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10994-020-05910-7
- [statement] In their empirical study, the authors suggest that blocked cross-validation can be applied to stationary time series. (low confidence) — https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10994-020-05910-7
- [statement] A doctoral thesis applies walk-forward cross-validated trading backtests to 30-minute futures time series. (low confidence) — https://livrepository.liverpool.ac.uk/3182263/1/201282530_Jun2024.pdf
- [statement] The ForeComp working paper frames comparison of two competing forecasts at the same horizon against a shared target variable. (low confidence) — https://www.philadelphiafed.org/-/media/FRBP/Assets/working-papers/2026/wp26-38.pdf
